title: Lobbying and Product Recalls: A Study of the U.S. Automobile Industry
eligible_reason: Main design is an IV regression of recall counts on continuous firm lobbying expenditure in a firm-quarter panel (firm, year, quarter fixed effects). The only DiD is a single-firm case check (GM, Flint water crisis) summarized in prose and the Web Appendix, with one treated firm and one event date.
design_notes: JMR 60(4), 2023. Nine years of multisource automotive data. Endogenous continuous lobbying instrumented; ordered probit via conditional mixed process as a robustness check (Web Appendix Table W8). The GM Flint DiD is in the 'Robustness Assessments' paragraph, not a main table.
screener_notes: Not eligible. Continuous treatment with IV; the DiD is a single-unit, single-date appendix check. No replication package was listed in the batch file (package_dir and regressions_path empty); screening is from the article text only.
